verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online's own Intuit Intelligence chat answers natural-language questions about the user's data ("What's driving my profit?") with contextual answers, generates reports on request, and helps resolve anomalies. Payroll AI also proactively spots inconsistencies, so in-product AI insights and suggestions are directly documented. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and in-depth documentation (beyond marketing copy) of how proactive suggestions are surfaced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Ask anything—from “What’s driving my profit?” to “How are my invoices doing this month?”—and get instant, contextual answers in clear, concise language.
Speed up business by telling Intuit Intelligence chat to create invoices, help resolve anomalies, run payroll, generate reports, estimate tax savings, and more.
Ask for the reports that matter most to your business—top expenses, sales trends, industry benchmarking—and get them instantly.
Your Payroll AI proactively collects time and attendance data from your employees and spots inconsistencies
